title: Conditional Uniformization of Kähler Surfaces
summary: We prove that a complete noncompact Kähler surface with nonnegative Ricci and nonnegative quadratic orthogonal bisectional curvature is contractible, and hence homeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^4$, if it is simply connected at infinity. Under positive bisectional curvature, this removes the contractibility assumption from the conditional uniformization theorem of Datar--Pingali--Seshadri: strong Steinness and simple connectivity at infinity suffice to identify the surface biholomorphically with $\mathbb{C}^2$.
